# arianet_locations (Data Source)

Datacenters (locations) resources can be created in (`GET /cloud/v1/datacenters`). Their `code` is the `datacenter` argument of every resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_locations" "all" {}

output "datacenters" {
  value = data.arianet_locations.all.codes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `codes` (List of String) Codes of every listed datacenter.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup.
- `locations` (Attributes List) The datacenters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City.
- `code` (String) Code (the `datacenter` argument).
- `country` (String) Country code.
- `features` (List of String) Features, e.g. `ipv6`, `private_networks`.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Whether IPv6 is offered.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `name_fa` (String) Persian name.
- `orderable` (Boolean) Whether new resources can be created there now.
- `status` (String) Status.
